datadir.description: The directory where ProxySQL stores its database and logs.

errorlog.description: The path to the ProxySQL error log file.

admin_credentials.description: The username:password pair for the ProxySQL admin interface.

admin_bind_address.description: The IP address and port for the ProxySQL admin interface.

threads.description: The number of threads used to handle connections.

max_connections.description: The maximum number of connections allowed.

default_query_timeout.description: The default timeout for queries in milliseconds.

poll_timeout.description: The timeout for poll() in milliseconds.

mysql_bind_address.description: The IP address and port for the MySQL listener interface.

stacksize.description: The stack size for threads in bytes.

server_version.description: The server version string to report to clients.

connect_timeout_server.description: The timeout for connecting to backend servers in milliseconds.

monitor_username.description: The username for the ProxySQL monitor user.

monitor_password.description: The password for the ProxySQL monitor user.

monitor_history.description: The history retention time for monitor statistics in milliseconds.

monitor_connect_interval.description: The interval for monitor connection checks in milliseconds.

monitor_ping_interval.description: The interval for monitor ping checks in milliseconds.

monitor_read_only_interval.description: The interval for checking read-only status in milliseconds.

monitor_read_only_timeout.description: The timeout for checking read-only status in milliseconds.

ping_interval_server_msec.description: The interval for pinging backend servers in milliseconds.

ping_timeout_server.description: The timeout for pinging backend servers in milliseconds.

connect_retries_on_failure.description: The number of retries for failed connections.
